mentions.name: Still Kicking
mentions.description: A picture-frame device that monitors the motion of an elderly person living alone, detecting falls and sleep quality and sending basic reports to a phone app. It is built from an mmWave sensor connected to an ESP32, and a planned commercial version would include a small cell modem so it works with no networking setup and acts as a gateway when more than one unit is in a house.
mentions.problem: The author's mother lives alone and is getting to the point where she might not be able to live alone; the device aims to give her more time at home.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built "Still Kicking", a picture frame that monitors her motion and sends back basic reports and can detect falls and sleep quality to a phone app, to help give her more time at home.
